answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one tundra weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The vertex report makes public the merge explicitly at each cipher. Because of that, an hostile operator who spins up 168 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 234 times the capital for one share. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 40 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
